company.name: College Pulse
company.shortDescription: College Pulse is a polling platform designed to aggregate and share student public opinion on college campuses.
company.description: College Pulse is a revolutionary platform that provides students with an accurate and less invasive way to measure public opinion. It recognizes the value of students' time and thoughts, which is why it provides them with information about what their community thinks about issues that are important to them. Because of this student-centric approach, they have grown to become the largest and most reliable source of college student opinion.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 92.59% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,530,605 to $9,960,237, a 3.94x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
